attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-detail production location reference key for an original action webtoon. One landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG, single establishing view. A modern Korean Hunter Association hearing room, Wednesday 10 AM. Camera 1.6 m eye level, wide 24 mm lens from the back just to the left of the central aisle, one horizon, looking past the public gallery toward a raised panel desk. Rectangular room approximately 12 m wide, 18 m deep, 5 m ceiling. Entire walls panelled in large muted warm-brown walnut panels, black ink seams, plain grey carpeted floor, no ornament. Front/far end: a long raised panel desk on a 0.45 m two-step dais, THREE empty grey evaluator chairs behind it, a little microphone at each place, blank unlettered nameplates. Midroom: exactly TWO separate rectangular wood tables, one on the LEFT and one on the RIGHT, both facing the raised panel desk; their chairs are on the camera side of the tables, facing forward toward the evaluators. Clear aisle between tables. A modest witness microphone stand at the right side of the dais. Rear/foreground: public gallery of simple empty benches, separated from the hearing floor by a wooden rail 1.1 m high with a central swing gate aligned to the centre aisle. The closest gallery benches and rail are cropped at the bottom edge to anchor camera position. One regular 2.1 m door in the far-left side wall, appropriate 18 cm step risers. Named KEY LIGHT: cool white rectangular ceiling panels visible overhead, creating a few broad cool hard-edged cel shadows. Secondary morning daylight from tall windows with vertical blinds on the right wall makes clean narrow daylight bars on wall and floor, no fog. Cool slate-grey base with muted brown wood, institutional and quiet. Only TWO tiny generic 1.75 m adult grey-uniform staff for scale, one mid-step by the far-left door with a folder, one standing by the right-hand table holding papers at waist level with head turned toward the dais. Full 7.5-head adult proportions with legs half their height, feet grounded on the same room perspective. They must remain very small compared with the room, no featured named cast, no audience, no proceedings. All furniture physically supported, chairs sensible, complete clean rectangular table legs, consistent perspective. Three chairs behind the panel desk, gallery visibly BEHIND the rail on camera side; do not turn it into a courtroom with a judge throne or a pulpit. Keep the upper wall area quiet for future lettering, but DO NOT draw text. The attached APPROVED location image supplies only the crisp V2 hand-inked architectural rendering; do not copy its architecture, white marble floor, night windows or composition. Use broad opaque cel planes, visible ink lines, controlled wood flat colour, no photographic textures, no screens necessary in this room.
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
